اعتنقتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَنَقْتُنَّ (iʕtanaqtunna) /iʕ.ta.naq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# اُعْتُنِقْتُنَّ (uʕtuniqtunna) /uʕ.tu.niq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
